summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Colours & Fonts' (Theme) panel on the wifetobe site. Logged in as admin@wifetobe.org, opened Theme modal from dashboard, exercised swatch picker, hex input, font selects, live preview, save, persistence, invalid-hex validation, and Reset to default. Cross-verified render injection by fetching /api/editor/page/wifetobe/home directly and asserting the presence/absence of --brand-accent CSS var and Google Fonts <link> for Playfair Display / Manrope. All acceptance criteria met. wifetobe theme cleaned up (reset) at end of run.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeModal: the Save button is correctly gated on !data (waits for GET /theme), which is good; however Reset is only gated on 'busy', so a user could theoretically click 'Reset to default' before initial data load. Low priority since payload is a hard clear anyway.
seed_data_creation: None. Only the wifetobe site's branding.theme was toggled (set to accent #2563EB / Playfair Display / Manrope) then reset to defaults at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme feature verified end-to-end on frontend. Verified acceptance points: (1) 'Colours & Fonts' button on dashboard opens theme-panel; (2) swatch theme-swatch-2563EB updates theme-accent-hex to #2563EB; (3) heading/body font selects populated (successfully selected 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' by label); (4) Save closes modal and shows success toast 'Theme saved — open a page or hit Preview to see it'; (5) GET /api/editor/page/wifetobe/home returns HTML containing '--brand-accent:#2563EB' AND a googleapis.com/css2 link containing both Playfair+Display and Manrope; (6) Persistence: re-opening the modal shows accent=#2563EB, heading=Playfair Display, body=Manrope; (7) Invalid hex 'notacolor' surfaces theme-error 'Accent colour must be a hex value like #C82829.' from a 400; (8) Reset clears accent/heading/body in modal AND the rendered page no longer contains --brand-accent or 2563EB. wifetobe theme is cleared. No follow-up needed.
